name: interpret_light_reading
description: Interpret a KY-018 ADC reading as a calibrated relative light level. This does not measure lux.

adcMax.description: Maximum ADC value for the configured TinyDuino firmware.

darkReference.description: ADC value recorded in the chosen dark reference condition.

brightReference.description: ADC value recorded in the chosen bright reference condition.

execution.code: const input = typeof data === "string" ? JSON.parse(data) : data; const adc = Number(input?.adc); const adcMax = Number(input?.adcMax ?? 1023); const darkReference = Number(input?.darkReference); const brightReference = Number(input?.brightReference); if (![adc, adcMax, darkReference, brightReference].every(Number.isFinite)) throw new Error("Provide finite ADC values and both calibration references."); if (adcMax <= 0 || adc < 0 || adc > adcMax) throw new Error("The reading must be between 0 and adcMax, and adcMax must be positive."); if ([darkReference, brightReference].some(value => value < 0 || value > adcMax)) throw new Error("Calibration references must be between 0 and adcMax."); if (darkReference === brightReference) throw new Error("Dark and bright references must be different."); const relativePercent = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, ((adc - darkReference) / (brightReference - darkReference)) * 100)); const level = relativePercent < 10 ? "very dark" : relativePercent < 35 ? "dim" : relativePercent < 70 ? "moderate" : "bright"; return JSON.stringify({ adc, adcMax, relativePercent: Number(relativePercent.toFixed(1)), level, note: "Relative position between the supplied calibration references; not a lux measurement." });
